summary: Converts CHOP sample data into TOP pixels using channel grouping, layout, clamp, and pixel-format controls.

key_params.name: dataformat
key_params.note: Packing format: r, rg, rgb, rgba, a, or legacy

key_params.name: clamp
key_params.note: Clamp sample values before writing pixels

key_params.name: layout
key_params.note: Image layout: rowscropped, rowswrapped, or square

key_params.name: rgba
key_params.note: Fill value for extra or missing channels/pixels

common_gotchas: Channel names such as r0 or b1 do not determine placement; order in the CHOP does.
Extra pixels or missing channels use the RGBA fill values.
Maximum texture width can crop or wrap long CHOP data depending on layout.
Use float pixel formats when negative or high-range channel values matter.
key_concepts: CHOP to TOP converts CHOP samples into image pixels.
Data Format controls whether samples are packed as R, RG, RGB, RGBA, Alpha, or legacy data.
Channel order controls packing; CHOP channel names do not determine placement.
Layout controls rows cropped, rows wrapped, or square texture placement.
Default output precision is 32-bit float, useful for data textures and negative values.
Square layout is useful for point-cloud-style data textures.
